description: This file defines the Relationship class within the SuiteCRM JSON API resource namespace. It extends ResourceIdentifier and manages relationships between resources, including setting relationship names, types, and associated resource identifiers. It provides methods to convert relationships to JSON API response format and to associate related resources.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Represents a resource relationship in JSON API, allowing setting relationship details, associating related resources, and outputting JSON API formatted relationship data.

methods.name: setRelationshipName
methods.description: Sets the name of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the type of the relationship (TO_ONE or TO_MANY).

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the type of relationship, validating against supported types.

methods.name: withResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Associates a related ResourceIdentifier with this relationship and returns a cloned instance.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Converts the relationship into a JSON API response array depending on the relationship type.

methods.name: withResourceObject
methods.description: Internal method to set the link property with a related resource object, ensuring type consistency.
